minutes.headline: Zoning board moved to grant a special permit for outside display at Powell Stone and Gravel; vote result not audible
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard a petition from Powell Stone and Gravel for a special permit for outside storage and display in front of its building on Lemon Shirley Road. The board confirmed the road setback and agreed to add wording covering display bins under the building overhang. A motion to grant was made and seconded, and the meeting adjourned.

votes.motion: Grant the special permit as requested, adding wording allowing outside storage under the building overhang out for 2 ft, including the marked areas on the drawing.

decisions.decision: Board agreed the approval would include wording allowing display up to about 2 feet out under the covered area against the building.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals moved to grant Powell Stone and Gravel a special permit for outside storage and display; the vote result is not audible.
The board agreed the approval would include wording allowing display out about 2 feet under the covered area against the building.
Board members asked about the road setback, granite curbing and display bins under the overhang before the motion.
No one spoke for or against the petition, and a question about lighting was raised.
The motion to grant was made and seconded, findings were read, and the meeting adjourned.

why_it_matters: A special permit sets what a business may display outdoors on a commercial road, so the added overhang wording defines how far goods can extend in front of the building.
Because the recording does not capture the vote, the written decision filed by the board is the record that confirms whether the permit was granted.
